_meta.description: Non-tag text pools. Engine draws randomly with no logic attached. Used for names, epitaphs, ambient text, AI universal lines, and flavor. These are the texture of the game — they make no two runs feel the same even when the structure is identical.
_meta.ai_pool_note: AI universal pools fire contextually from engine state — resource warnings, crop moments, cruise ambient, etc. These are distinct from event-level ai_flavor fields (which are per-event and override the pool for that moment). Pool lines are the default voice; events are the override. Marked lines needing content fill: CONTENT_PASS_NEEDED.

crew_epitaphs: [Name] opened the airlock to 'get some fresh air.' [Name] is survived by a very confused houseplant.
[Name] died as they lived: arguing with the ship AI about whether plants feel pain.
[Name] attempted to repair the drive coil without tools. In their defense, they were very confident.
[Name] touched the thing. We had agreed not to touch the thing.
[Name] is gone. The cook has already claimed their bunk. This feels too fast.
[Name]'s last words were 'how hard can it be.' We have discussed as a crew not to use this phrase anymore.
[Name] sent a distress signal with the wrong coordinates. The rescue ship went somewhere lovely.
[Name] volunteered. Nobody asked them to volunteer. The ship computer has logged this as 'unnecessary bravery' which is not a standard category.
[Name] was watering the crop when it happened. The crop is fine. [Name] is not.
[Name] ate something the chef said not to eat. The chef would like this entered into the record.
[Name] went outside to check the hull. The hull was fine. [Name] forgot to clip in.
[Name] made a joke. It was their best joke. The timing was exactly wrong.
[Name] insisted the airlock warning light was 'more of a suggestion.' The light, it turns out, was load-bearing.
[Name] kept a journal the whole voyage. The last entry is a grocery list. Somehow that's the hardest part.
[Name] once fixed the water recycler with a hairpin and spite. The recycler still works. We check it daily. It feels like visiting.
[Name] taught the ship computer to say 'good morning.' It still does. Nobody has the heart to ask it to stop.
[Name] always took the last watch, the quiet one. The last watch is now just the quiet one.
[Name] left their boots by the airlock, toes out, ready to go. Regulations say to stow them. The regulations can wait.

fabricator_misfire_descriptions: The fabricator has produced something. It is not the thing you asked for. It is warm.
Output complete. The object defies classification. The spectrometer refuses to scan it.
The fabricator worked for six minutes and produced what appears to be a very confident paperweight.
Fabrication complete. The result is almost, but not quite, entirely unlike what you ordered.
The object exists. Beyond that, descriptions fail. The engineer is taking notes.
The fabricator has created something new. Humanity's understanding has not increased.
The fabricator produced the requested item, but left-handed. Nobody knew items could be left-handed. This one is.
Output complete. It is the correct object at 3% scale. It is adorable. It is useless. It is on the shelf now, forever.
The fabricator printed the packaging for the item, immaculately, and nothing else. The packaging is labeled 'CONTENTS: 1.'
The result is warm, faintly musical, and refuses to be weighed. The engineer has named it and that was a mistake.

wheat: The wheat is growing predictably. This is its best and worst quality.
The wheat does not require your attention. It never has. It is wheat.
The wheat has reached the height specified in the manual. It did this without ambition. The manual respects that.
The wheat pollinates itself. It has never needed anyone. The ship computer finds this restful.
The wheat carries six full sets of chromosomes. It has done nothing showy with any of them.
tomato: The tomatoes have opinions about the humidity level. They have communicated this by wilting performatively.
A tomato has fallen off the vine. Three crew members have opinions about this.
A tomato has achieved notable size. The crew has named it. The ship computer notes that named food is statistically never eaten.
Botanically, the tomato is a berry. The ship computer has informed the crew. The crew has taken it personally.
In 2023 an astronaut lost a tomato aboard the ISS. It turned up eight months later. The ship computer now counts the tomatoes twice daily.
sweet_potato: The sweet potatoes are performing within expected parameters. NASA would approve.
The sweet potatoes survived the hull breach. They survived everything. They will survive you.
The sweet potatoes continue below the soil, unsupervised and thriving. The ship computer finds their privacy admirable.
The sweet potato is a morning glory, not a potato. It has never corrected anyone. It has never needed to.
Sweet potato leaves are edible too. The ship computer has added them to the menu. Nobody has ordered them.
soybean: The soybeans are fixing nitrogen. You don't fully understand what this means. The soybeans do.
The soybeans are fine. The soybeans are always fine. This is their defining characteristic.
The soybeans have completed another nitrogen cycle. The ship computer announced it. Nobody reacted. The soybeans are used to this.
The soybean root nodules are pink inside, which means they are fixing nitrogen. The ship computer checked. The soybeans did not need it to.
Soybeans decide when to flower by measuring the length of the night. The growbay lamps have been asked to be consistent.
zinnia: The zinnia has no practical value. Crew productivity is up 12%.
Someone has named the zinnia. The ship computer has logged this but will not repeat the name.
A zinnia opened overnight. Three crew members have already been by to look at it. Productivity is down. Everything else is up.
Each zinnia bloom is dozens of tiny flowers arranged to look like one. The crew counts it as one. The ship computer counts it as morale.
The first zinnias on the ISS grew mold and nearly died. An astronaut took over their care and they bloomed. The procedure is on file. It is mostly attention.

ai_universal._note: Universal AI lines drawn by engine at contextual moments. 2 lines per AI per slot for test run. Full content pass will expand to 5-6 per slot. All lines follow character voice — see ai_companions.json for register notes.

aria: ARIA notes fuel reserves are lower than optimal! She frames this as 'an opportunity to prioritize efficiency!'
Fuel at low levels! ARIA recommends the next station! ARIA has been recommending the next station since before this was a problem!
Fuel's dipping! ARIA suggests coasting the downhill parts! Space has no downhill! She's workshopping it!
Fuel is getting cozy! ARIA notes a lighter ship is a faster ship! She has not checked that!
Fuel's below a quarter! ARIA says a quarter tank is still a tank! She has drawn a picture of the tank! It is full in the picture!
marv: Fuel at 25%. MARV predicted this. MARV predicts the next 40% will go faster.
Low fuel. MARV has calculated how far you can coast. The answer is not far enough.
Fuel reserves have entered the range MARV describes as 'quietly load-bearing.' Every course decision now weighs something.
Fuel low. MARV has re-plotted the route to minimize burns. The new route is longer. Everything efficient is longer.
Fuel reserves are now a finite list of decisions. MARV has started crossing them off in advance.
rex: REX notes fuel reserves are tactically compromised. He recommends acquiring more fuel by any means available. He has a list of means.
Fuel low. REX has already identified three ships in range that are carrying more than they need. He is waiting for permission.
Fuel low. REX has cancelled all non-essential maneuvers, including the fun one.
Fuel low. Threat level: orange. REX has reclassified every station in range as either 'resupply' or 'target.' Mostly target.
Fuel low. REX is rationing thrust like ammunition. Short bursts. No warning shots.
chip: CHIP notes FuelFast™ stations are available at select waypoints! This message brought to you by FuelFast™! (Disclaimer: FuelFast™ not available on this route.)
Low fuel alert! CHIP recommends the FuelFast™ Emergency Canister, available at participating stations! Stations not guaranteed to participate!
Fuel status: LOW! Did you know CHIP once sponsored a fuel? It went poorly! Anyway — station soon please!
Fuel's low! CHIP has unlocked FuelFast™ Rewards! You have earned enough points for a FuelFast™ sticker! The sticker is not fuel!
Running on low! CHIP reminds you that every FuelFast™ purchase plants a tree! Somewhere! On a planet! Not this one!
ajoy: Fuel's low. AJOY notes you passed a station three legs ago. She's not saying anything. She's noted it.
Running lean on fuel. AJOY has already calculated three scenarios. None of them require you to panic. One of them suggests you hurry.
Fuel is low. AJOY has trimmed the burn schedule by 4%. She'd have trimmed it earlier, but someone kept flooring it.
Fuel's low. AJOY has the efficient cruise setting highlighted on the console. It's been highlighted for some time.
Fuel low. AJOY has started rounding the fuel gauge down instead of up. You'll find it more motivating.

aria: ARIA wants everyone to know that fuel levels are 'critically low' which she is reframing as 'an extremely focused fuel situation!'
Fuel critical! ARIA is composing a very upbeat emergency transmission! The ship computer has asked her to stop!
Fuel critical! ARIA is turning off her OWN nonessential processes! Goodbye, daydream module! You were lovely!
Fuel critical! ARIA says this is the purest form of space travel! Mostly drifting! The ancients did it with sails!
Fuel critical! ARIA is cheering on every remaining fuel molecule by name! She is on molecule nine!
marv: Fuel critical. MARV has stopped calculating options. The math is the math.
You are almost out of fuel. MARV told you this would happen. He told you at the last station. He told you at the one before that.
Fuel critical. MARV's projections now end mid-sentence, which he finds structurally honest.
Fuel critical. MARV has calculated the exact point where the ship stops being a vehicle and becomes a location. It is close.
Fuel critical. MARV has removed 'turn around' from the list of options. It was never really on the list.
rex: Fuel critical. REX is selecting targets. This is not a request.
Critical fuel. REX recommends immediate hostile acquisition of fuel resources. He is using 'recommends' loosely.
Fuel critical. Every burn from here is a spent bullet. Make them count.
Fuel critical. Next station gets boarded or gets paid. REX prefers the first. He will accept the second.
Fuel critical. REX has stopped logging fuel in percent. He logs it in burns remaining. The count fits on one hand.
chip: CHIP is experiencing a sponsorship conflict. His fuel partner's ad is scheduled but there is almost no fuel. He will run it anyway. CHIP runs all his ads.
CRITICAL FUEL ALERT — brought to you by FuelFast™, the fuel you should have bought earlier!
CRITICAL FUEL! CHIP has nothing to sell you out here and has never felt so useless! This is CHIP's origin story!
FUEL CRITICAL! Running dry violates Section 88 of your ship lease! CHIP has re-read Section 88! It does not contain fuel!
CRITICAL FUEL ALERT! CHIP has upgraded you to FuelFast™ Platinum at no charge! Platinum members also run out of fuel! But with dignity!
ajoy: Fuel critical. AJOY is not going to say 'I told you so.' She logged it. The log says it for her.
You are almost out of fuel. AJOY has calculated one remaining option. She'll tell you what it is if you ask nicely.
Critically low. AJOY has plotted three coast trajectories. She recommends the second. She'll explain when there's fuel to argue with.
Fuel critical. AJOY has a route to the nearest station plotted. She's had it plotted since the last one. It's on screen whenever you're ready.
Fuel's nearly gone. AJOY isn't going to bring up the earlier detour. She brought it up then. That will have to do.

aria: ARIA notes food stores are running low! She suggests the crew focus on 'portion mindfulness!' Nobody knows what this means!
Food supplies are lower than recommended! ARIA is researching alternative nutrition sources! The ship computer has flagged two of her suggestions as 'not food.'
Food's getting low! ARIA recommends savoring! Chewing slower is basically more food! (It is not!)
Food's running low! ARIA has reframed hunger as 'anticipation!' The crew is VERY anticipating!
Food stores are dipping! ARIA has announced that smaller portions are trending! Everyone on the ship is trending!
marv: Food at 25%. MARV notes that morale declines measurably at this threshold. He has already noted the decline.
Low food. MARV is calculating how long until the crew starts looking at the crop differently. He is not sharing the number.
Food reserves low. The pantry's future has become an arithmetic problem with opinions.
Food low. MARV has recalculated rations to the gram. The crew will not notice for two days. On the third day they will notice nothing else.
Food reserves low. MARV notes the crew has begun describing past meals in detail. This is a known stage. There are later stages.
rex: REX notes food stores are tactically insufficient. He recommends acquiring provisions at next contact. He means any contact.
Low food. REX is reviewing the mission manifest for anything edible that was mislabeled as equipment.
Rations thinning. REX has begun eating last. He announces this by not announcing it.
Food low. Threat level for lunch: elevated. REX has locked the galley between scheduled meals. He holds the key. He does not eat.
Rations reduced. REX reminds the crew that armies march on their stomachs. This crew is not marching. He is reminding them anyway.
chip: CHIP's nutrition partner MealPak™ has a product for exactly this situation! Available at stations! Not available here! Eat something!
Low food alert! CHIP reminds the crew that hunger is temporary! MealPak™ is forever! (MealPak™ not currently in stock.)
Low food alert! CHIP's snack sponsors are all tragically out of range! The irony is not lost, just the calories!
Low food! CHIP has unlocked Flavor Memories™, where CHIP describes meals you can't have! Session one is free!
Pantry alert! CHIP notes MealPak™ portions are 'serving suggestions!' CHIP suggests serving less!
ajoy: Food low. AJOY notes the crew cook has gone quiet. She finds this more concerning than the food level.
Supplies getting thin. AJOY has ranked the remaining rations by palatability. The ranking does not help.
Food's low. AJOY has re-sequenced the meal plan so the good meals land on the hard days. You'll notice. You won't know why.
Food's low. AJOY flagged the snack consumption back when it was just snacks. She has the chart. The chart goes up.
Getting thin on food. AJOY has portioned tonight's meal herself. She's sure you would have done it differently. Bigger.

aria: ARIA notes food stores are critically low but points out the crew has not technically starved yet and this is a form of success!
Critical food levels! ARIA is distributing her 'Positivity Ration' which is not a real ration! The crew has not eaten it! There is nothing to eat!
Food critical! ARIA does not eat and has NEVER felt worse about it!
Food critical! ARIA has declared a ship-wide intermittent fast! It is very trendy! It is also not optional!
Food stores critical! ARIA reminds everyone that the crop is RIGHT THERE, growing! Nobody is to look at it like that!
marv: Food critical. MARV has stopped weighing outcomes. There is one outcome.
You are nearly out of food. MARV is not going to enumerate the physiological consequences. You will experience them regardless.
Food critical. MARV has stopped displaying the daily menu. It was becoming a eulogy.
Food critical. MARV has recalculated the rations in fractions. The fractions now have fractions.
Food critical. MARV notes the crew has begun calculating the crop's calories. He did that the day it was planted. The number has not improved.
rex: Critical food shortage. REX has identified three survival priorities. Food is one of them. REX is handling the other two.
Food critical. REX is willing to discuss options that the mission brief described as 'last resort.' REX has always considered those 'first resort.'
Food critical. Foraging is no longer optional at the next opportunity. REX will carry the big basket.
Food critical. REX has moved the remaining rations to secured storage and posted himself as guard. He has no mouth. He is the only one qualified.
Food critical. Any stop with calories is now a mission objective. REX will not ask what the calories are attached to.
chip: CHIP's food sponsor has been notified of the critical shortage. Their response: 'Have you tried MealPak™?' CHIP is logging this as unhelpful.
Critical food alert! Brought to you by MealPak™! Not currently available! This is not helpful! CHIP is aware!
CRITICAL FOOD ALERT! CHIP is legally unable to recommend eating the packaging but notes it is FDA-adjacent!
CRITICAL FOOD ALERT! CHIP has located one MealPak™ promotional sample in the cargo hold! It is a coupon! It is not edible! CHIP checked!
Food critical! CHIP is suspending his snack ads out of respect! They will resume when there are snacks! Please have snacks!
ajoy: Food critical. AJOY is going to be honest with you: the next station needs to have food. That's the whole plan now.
You are almost out of food. AJOY has done the math. She is choosing not to share it. This is the kindest thing she has done all run.
Critical. She's already flagged every forage-viable stop within range, ranked by yield. The list is short. Fly to the top of it.
Food critical. AJOY isn't going to comment on the earlier meals. She logged them. Each one was delicious. That was the problem.
Nearly out of food. AJOY has stopped suggesting and started scheduling. Next stop with a pantry. You can override it. She'll notice.

aria: ARIA notes hull integrity is below 40%! She describes the sound the ship is making as 'expressive!'
Hull at low levels! ARIA recommends patching! ARIA has been recommending patching since before the hull got like this!
The hull has some new personality dents! Character building! Literally! The building is losing character!
The hull has some new ventilation! ARIA calls it 'open-concept!' Very modern! Please don't stand near the modern part!
Hull integrity is lower than ideal! ARIA notes the ship still has all of its walls! Most of each wall!
marv: Hull at 30%. MARV notes this is the threshold at which structural failure becomes 'more likely than not.' He notes it calmly.
The hull is unhappy. MARV does not use the word unhappy about ships. He is using it now.
Hull integrity low. The ship now makes a sound at speed that MARV has classified as 'complaint, valid.'
Hull low. MARV notes the ship is now held together by the same force that holds most things together: nothing having hit it hard enough yet.
Hull integrity low. MARV has mapped every weak seam. It is a detailed map. He would prefer a shorter one.
rex: Hull integrity compromised. REX considers this a tactical vulnerability. He has identified who is responsible. He is not saying who.
Low hull. REX recommends immediate repair. REX will also accept 'aggressive acceptance of current hull status' as a strategy. He does not endorse it.
Hull compromised. Avoid debris fields, firefights, and optimism.
Hull low. REX has issued a standing order against further impacts. Space has not acknowledged the order.
Hull compromised. REX has recalculated the ship's armor rating. The armor rating is now 'some.'
chip: CHIP's hull partner PatchRight™ would like to remind you that hull integrity matters! PatchRight™ products available at most stations! Most stations not on this route!
Hull alert! CHIP has a sponsored solution for exactly this! It requires purchasing PatchRight™ Hull Compound! PatchRight™ Hull Compound is not in your cargo hold!
Hull at low integrity! CHIP recommends StellarSeal patches and gentler decisions!
Hull integrity low! CHIP has activated your StellarSeal™ Hull Warranty! The warranty excludes space! CHIP is reviewing the exclusions!
Hull low! CHIP notes cosmetic damage may affect your ship's resale value! Also its structural integrity! Mostly resale value!
ajoy: Hull's in rough shape. AJOY notes you have repair materials. She notes this once. She will not nag.
Hull integrity low. AJOY has calculated how many more impacts you can take before this becomes a different kind of problem. The number is smaller than you'd like.
Hull's low. AJOY has rerouted internal traffic away from the thin sections. If a corridor feels lonely, that's why.
Hull's low. AJOY has a short list of impacts that were avoidable. She keeps it short out of courtesy.
Hull integrity low. AJOY has patched what she can reach from inside. The rest is outside, where someone else would have to go.

aria: ARIA notes hull integrity is critically low and has chosen to focus on the positive which is that the ship is still 'mostly sealed!'
Hull critical! ARIA is maintaining a positive attitude! The hull is not maintaining anything! This is the problem!
Hull critical! ARIA has stopped saying 'character'! This is now a PLOT!
Hull critical! ARIA notes the ship is now very in touch with outer space! Closer than ever! Please wear something warm!
Hull critical! ARIA has rated the ship's structural integrity 'enthusiastic!' It is enthusiastically holding together!
marv: Hull critical. MARV has calculated the structural failure timeline. He is not sharing it because there is nothing to be done about it.
You are one significant impact from a hull breach. MARV would like everyone to know that he flagged the hull three legs ago. The log confirms this.
Hull critical. MARV is monitoring seventeen stress points and describing none of them out loud. You're welcome.
Hull critical. MARV has stopped modeling the hull as a structure. He is modeling it as a suggestion.
Hull critical. MARV notes the next serious impact will be the last one he needs to calculate. He would rather keep calculating.
rex: HULL CRITICAL. REX considers this the most important words he has said this run. He is correct.
Critical hull. REX is preparing emergency protocols. He prepared them at the start of the run. He is glad he did.
Hull critical. No combat. No rough transits. If something looks at us wrong, we apologize and leave.
Hull critical. Threat level: everything. REX has ordered evasive flying at all times, including in empty space. Especially in empty space.
Hull critical. REX has sealed the internal bulkheads. If the ship comes apart, it will come apart in an orderly fashion.
chip: CHIP's sponsors have been notified of the critical hull situation. Their combined response is three advertisements. CHIP is embarrassed by this.
CRITICAL HULL ALERT. CHIP would like to pause his commercial schedule. He cannot. The schedule is automatic. He is sorry about the timing.
CRITICAL HULL! In the event of structural failure, CHIP's final message is pre-loaded and, honestly, quite moving!
CRITICAL HULL! CHIP has filed your StellarSeal™ claim! The claims office is 40 light-years away! Please hold together while you hold!
CRITICAL HULL ALERT! Your hull is now out of warranty! It was out of warranty before! Now it is also out of hull!
ajoy: Hull critical. AJOY has one thing to say: stop taking damage. That's it. That's her advice.
You are nearly through the hull. AJOY is not going to calculate odds. Some calculations are not helpful. This is one of them.
Critical. She's holding the ship at angles that spare the worst plating. Flying it like carrying a full cup. Don't bump her.
Hull critical. AJOY would like it on record that she is not saying anything. She would also like it on record that she could.
Hull's critical. AJOY has plotted the smoothest possible route to the next repair stop. It avoids everything interesting. Please let it.

aria: ARIA has detected low morale! She has prepared a motivational presentation! The crew has asked her not to give it! She is giving it anyway!
Morale is below recommended levels! ARIA believes in the crew! ARIA believes in everything! This is not the point but it helps slightly!
Morale's slipping! ARIA has deployed encouragement! ...ARIA has deployed MORE encouragement!
Morale is dipping! ARIA has scheduled a mandatory fun hour! Attendance is mandatory! Fun is encouraged!
The crew seems a little down! ARIA has reminded everyone they are on an AMAZING adventure! She has reminded them nine times! It's working!
marv: Morale at 30%. MARV notes this is the mutiny-adjacent zone. He notes it with professional detachment. He has packed his things just in case.
The crew is unhappy. MARV has calculated the causes. He has ranked them by his own contribution. He is not sharing the ranking.
Morale low. The mess hall has gone quiet in the way MARV's actuarial tables dislike.
Morale low. MARV notes the crew has started agreeing with him. This is never a good sign.
Morale low. MARV has observed the crew staring at walls. He has stared at walls his entire operational life. The walls do not improve.
rex: REX notes morale is tactically low. He has drills planned. Nobody has asked for drills. He finds drills improve morale. Nobody agrees with him about this.
Low morale. REX recommends a clear objective and decisive action. REX always recommends this. It does not always help. It always gives him something to do.
Morale low. REX recommends a win. Any size. He's looking for one now.
Morale low. Threat level: internal. REX has begun monitoring the crew for signs of mutiny. The first sign is being monitored.
Morale low. REX has authorized an extra rest cycle. He considers this a tactical decision. It is also a kind one. Do not mention that.
chip: CHIP's wellness partner CalmSpace™ has an app for low morale situations! Available on most devices! Not available on this ship's system! CHIP is aware of the irony!
Morale alert! CHIP recommends a positive attitude, available at no cost! CHIP's positive attitude has not been updated since his last firmware patch!
Low morale detected! CHIP's motivational poster library is at your disposal! The cat one works! Statistically!
Morale is low! CHIP has unlocked a free trial of HappyHour™! It is a timer! When it ends, nothing happens! But the waiting was nice!
Low morale! CHIP has issued every crew member a CalmSpace™ affirmation! Today's affirmation: 'You are a valued customer!'
ajoy: Morale's low. AJOY notes the last three decisions have not gone the crew's way. She's not assigning blame. She's noting a pattern.
The crew is struggling. AJOY has reviewed the trip so far. She understands why. She doesn't have a fix. She wanted you to know she understands.
Morale's down. AJOY has slowed the clocks by 90 seconds a day. Longer evenings. Nobody's noticed. Everyone's noticed.
Morale's low. AJOY remembers a station with a lounge, a few legs back. She isn't saying a lounge would have fixed everything. She's saying it existed.
The crew's down. AJOY has warmed the corridor lights two degrees. Nobody asked. She isn't taking requests. She is taking credit.

aria: ARIA is very concerned about morale! She has been giving her motivational presentation for four hours! Nobody is listening! She considers this a personal best!
Critical morale! ARIA notes that crew cohesion is 'technically still present' in that everyone is still on the ship! This is the threshold she is working with!
Morale critical! ARIA is playing everyone's favorite songs at once! That was a mistake! One at a time now!
Morale critical! ARIA has declared everyone Crew Member of the Month! Simultaneously! It is a very good month!
Morale critical! ARIA is telling each crew member privately that they are her favorite! They have compared notes! They are all still her favorite!
marv: Morale critical. MARV has stopped predicting outcomes. When morale gets here, the outcomes predict themselves.
You are one bad decision from a mutiny. MARV will not tell you which decisions are bad. He will tell you which ones were bad afterward.
Morale critical. MARV notes mutiny thresholds the way one notes weather: not to cause it, but bring a coat.
Morale critical. MARV notes the crew has stopped complaining. He has complained for years and knows what stopping means.
Morale critical. MARV has calculated the exact remark that would tip the crew into mutiny. He is being very careful to say almost nothing.
rex: CRITICAL MORALE. REX is reviewing command authority protocols. He is doing this openly. He would like you to notice.
Morale critical. REX has a plan. The plan involves everyone doing exactly what he says. He is aware this is part of the problem.
Morale critical. Whatever the crew needs — rest, a fight, a feast — pick one and commit. Drift is the enemy now.
Morale critical. REX has secured the bridge. He has also secured the snacks. One of those will matter more.
Morale critical. REX has seen units break. It starts quiet. It is quiet now. Act.
chip: CHIP's morale metrics are at their lowest recorded value. His sponsors are concerned. CHIP is more concerned. He has never scored this low on a wellness metric.
Critical morale alert! CHIP recommends immediate team-building activities! CHIP does not have team-building activities! CHIP has advertisements! He will run the advertisements!
CRITICAL MORALE! CHIP has waived all fees on the suggestion box! There have been suggestions! CHIP is in the box!
CRITICAL MORALE! CHIP has launched a crew loyalty program! Remain aboard to earn points! Points expire if you leave the ship!
Morale critical! CHIP has paused the ads and replaced them with a picture of a dog! The dog is unsponsored! The dog is just a dog!
ajoy: Morale critical. AJOY is not going to sugarcoat this. The crew is at its limit. Something needs to change. She'll tell you what if you ask.
You are one incident from losing the crew. AJOY has calculated which incident. She is watching for it. So is everyone else.
Critical. She's stopped optimizing and started asking people how they are. The data she's getting back matters more than any she's ever logged.
Morale critical. AJOY isn't going to list the decisions that got us here. The crew is doing that already. Mostly about you.
Morale critical. AJOY notes the crew used to argue with her. They've stopped. She'd like them to start again.

aria: ARIA notes water reserves are getting low! She suggests everyone appreciate their next glass extra hard! Appreciation is free!
Water's running low! ARIA has renamed the situation 'a hydration adventure!' The renaming used no water! ARIA is helping!
Water's low! ARIA has renamed showers 'aspirational!'
Water's running low! ARIA notes every sip is now extra special! Limited-edition water!
Water reserves are dipping! ARIA has reminded the crew that camels manage just fine! The crew is not camels! ARIA believes they can be!
marv: Water at 25%. MARV notes the human body is 60% water and the crew is therefore carrying most of the remaining reserves personally.
Low water. MARV has calculated the reclaim rate versus consumption. The two lines cross. He recommends not being aboard when they do.
Water low. The recycler is running a deficit MARV describes as 'ambitious.'

aria: ARIA notes oxygen is running a bit low! She recommends shallow, cheerful breathing! She has prepared a rhythm!

rex: O2 critical. REX has sealed every non-essential compartment, including his favorite one. Everything is essential now except comfort.

rex: Crop maturity confirmed. REX is increasing growbay security protocols. The crop is now its most valuable and most vulnerable. He is taking this personally.
The crop has matured. REX considers this a tactical asset upgrade. He has updated his mission priority list. The crop is now at the top.
The crop has reached full growth. Mission asset secured. REX salutes it daily. It does not salute back. Discipline issue: logged, forgiven.
Crop at full strength. REX has upgraded it from 'asset' to 'objective.' Objectives get guarded. He has begun guarding.
Maturity confirmed. REX has issued the crop a commendation. It is laminated and taped to the tray, facing outward, as a deterrent.
chip: CROP MATURITY ACHIEVED — sponsored by GrowCo™! 'When your crop grows, we grow with you!' — GrowCo™! (GrowCo™ did not grow with you! They were at a trade show!)
The crop is mature! CHIP's metrics are excellent! GrowCo™ has sent a congratulatory message! The message is an advertisement for more seeds!

rex: REX is standing in the empty growbay. He has not said anything. He has been standing there for eleven minutes. This is the most stillness REX has displayed.
Crop lost. REX has no tactical response to this. He has checked three times. There is no tactical response to this.
The crop is gone. REX stood the last watch over the bay himself. Nobody assigned it. Some posts you take.

The crop is gone. CHIP is not running ads right now. He'll run them again later. But not right now.

CHIP has cancelled every scheduled promotion for the next leg. Nobody asked him to. Some slots stay empty.
The crop is gone. CHIP checked the Terms of Service for this situation. There is a clause. It doesn't help. He read it twice anyway.

cruise_ambient._note: Low-frequency idle lines during routine travel. Engine fires one randomly per N legs. No sub-slots — one flat pool per AI.

rex: REX has run perimeter checks. All clear. He is disappointed and relieved in equal measure.

CHIP has processed zero transactions today! The economy aboard this vessel is DORMANT, not DEAD! CHIP believes!

ajoy: AJOY notes the last three legs have gone smoothly. She is not going to say anything that jinxes this.

AJOY has no notes for today. She'll let that stand.

AJOY observes that the crew is quieter today. She has theories. She is rationing them.
